recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the folder-plus-initials proposal. It keeps the folder for drafts only and releases through one controlled archive. That archive authenticates the reviewer, blocks author self-approval, records approval time against the exact document version, and locks the document and its approval record for seven years. There are no optional add-ons. One need is open: it is not yet confirmed whether the current platform can provide this archive, and the reply asks which platform hosts the folder.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The signed customer contract requires the exact approved version, approver identity and approval time retained for seven years, independent approval, and protection from later edits.
labels.Deleted: Typed initials and naming conventions as evidence of approval.
labels.Bottleneck: The editable folder cannot enforce these controls.
labels.Checked myself: You said authors can edit the folder; no platform capabilities have been verified.

note: The reply picks one controlled archive with every required capability, and its four record lines are specific and appear before the recommendation.
